About.heading: Knowledge, education and technology in one ecosystem.
About.body1: We believe societies progress through their ability to produce knowledge, develop people and offer continuous learning opportunities, while making conscious use of technological change.
About.body2: So we build connected solutions that serve every stage of learning and human development — from building children's skills to supporting researchers, academics, and professional and institutional development.

Technologies.heading: Connected solutions for research, training and knowledge digitization.
Technologies.body: Our research, OCR and publishing solutions can be used independently or combined.
Technologies.t1subheading: A digital environment for research work.
Technologies.t1body: A digital environment for researchers, academics and research teams that supports organizing the research workflow, working with references and documents, and collaboration — with AI-assisted tools, while verification and scientific judgment stay with the researcher.
Technologies.t2subheading: Double the value of your documents.
Technologies.t2body: Convert scanned images of Arabic and English documents into fully editable, searchable text files using the precise RDI engine.
Technologies.t3body: We prepare scientific and educational content for print and electronic publishing and follow the steps through. Two future tracks are in preparation: digitizing Islamic studies and manuscripts, and simplifying science for children.

hero.title: An integrated ecosystem for knowledge, education, consulting and technology
hero.description: We develop knowledge, empower people and design solutions that help individuals and institutions learn, research, innovate and grow.

intro.title: Institutional profile
intro.description1: Schobot is a company working in information and communications technology and in developing knowledge, educational, research and training solutions. Its vision is to use knowledge, specialist expertise and digital technology to offer products and services that help individuals and institutions learn, produce, collaborate and grow.
intro.description2: We are not a substitute for the person or the specialist. We build supportive tools and environments that strengthen their ability to reach knowledge, organize their work and improve productivity, while verification, evaluation and decision-making remain a human responsibility.
intro.description3: Our philosophy: people first, knowledge as the basis of progress, and technology as a tool for empowerment. We measure the value of solutions not by how new the technology is, but by their real benefit to the user, ease of use, quality of output, and respect for privacy and integrity.

mission.title: Integrated solutions for learning, research and collaboration
mission.description: To develop integrated educational, academic, research and technical solutions that combine human expertise, digital innovation and responsible AI, empowering individuals and institutions to learn, produce and collaborate efficiently.

vision.title: A trusted knowledge and technology ecosystem
vision.description: To be a trusted knowledge and technology ecosystem that contributes to developing education, scientific research and human empowerment, and to widening access to knowledge and learning.

principles.title: The researcher is the primary actor; AI is a tool that supports them

oversight.title: Human oversight
oversight.description: The user remains responsible for reviewing outputs, verifying them and making decisions.

transparency.description: Explaining the nature and limits of technical assistance where appropriate.

privacy.title: Privacy and data protection
privacy.description: Handling user data according to the policies and procedures actually adopted.

integrity.title: Academic integrity
integrity.description: Not encouraging plagiarism, fabricated sources, or presenting automated output as independent human work.
